atomic_facts.fact: Sam Bankman-Fried's full name is Samuel Benjamin Bankman-Fried.
Sam Bankman-Fried was born on March 5, 1992.
Sam Bankman-Fried founded the cryptocurrency exchange FTX.
As of 2026, Bankman-Fried is publicly characterized as the disgraced founder of FTX, with 2026 coverage identifying him primarily by that role.
Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud.
The conviction was a criminal conviction (United States v. Bankman-Fried, felony charges, federal jury), including related counts such as conspiracy and money laundering.
Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in prison.
The sentence was imposed on March 28, 2024.
In June 2026, a federal appeals court upheld Bankman-Fried's conviction and 25-year sentence, so the sentence was not altered on appeal.
As of September 2026, Bankman-Fried has appealed to the Supreme Court, asking for a new trial.
Bankman-Fried remains incarcerated, serving his 25-year sentence (interviewed from his prison cell; described as 'serving 25 years for fraud').
The sentence had not been altered by a pardon; his pardon request was pending and Trump said he had no intention of pardoning him.
Every source cited for this finding (Wikipedia, CNN, Forbes, NY Post, Reuters, NYT, PBS) reports a 25-year prison sentence.
None of the cited sources report a life sentence for Bankman-Fried.
